metric.label: Lexical baseline
metric.description: Character n-gram cosine distance. This is a reproducible lexical baseline, not a semantic or faithfulness score.

units.leftText: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands — this is the Word of life.
units.rightText: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we beheld, and our hands handled, concerning the Word of life

units.leftText: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
units.rightText: (and the life was manifested, and we have seen, and bear witness, and declare unto you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us);

units.leftText: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: that which we have seen and heard declare we unto you also, that ye also may have fellowship with us: yea, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ:

units.leftText: We write these things so that our joy may be complete. Walking in the Light (John 8:12–29|JHN 8:12-29*)
units.rightText: and these things we write, that our joy may be made full.
leftNotes: 1:4 BYZ and TR your

units.leftText: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
units.rightText: And this is the message which we have heard from him and announce unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

units.leftText: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
units.rightText: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

units.leftText: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
units.rightText: but if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
leftNotes: 1:7 NA does not include But.

units.leftText: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
units.rightText: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

units.leftText: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
units.rightText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

units.leftText: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
units.rightText: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

units.leftText: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father — Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
units.rightText: My little children, these things write I unto you that ye may not sin. And if any man sin, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

units.leftText: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
units.rightText: and he is the propitiation for our sins; and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
leftNotes: 2:2 Or the propitiation

units.leftText: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
units.rightText: And hereby we know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

units.leftText: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
units.rightText: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him;

units.leftText: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
units.rightText: but whoso keepeth his word, in him verily hath the love of God been perfected. Hereby we know that we are in him:

units.leftText: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked. A New Commandment
units.rightText: he that saith he abideth in him ought himself also to walk even as he walked.

units.leftText: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.
units.rightText: Beloved, no new commandment write I unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning: the old commandment is the word which ye heard.

units.leftText: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.
units.rightText: Again, a new commandment write I unto you, which thing is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shineth.

units.leftText: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
units.rightText: He that saith he is in the light and hateth his brother, is in the darkness even until now.

units.leftText: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.
units.rightText: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is no occasion of stumbling in him.

units.leftText: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
units.rightText: But he that hateth his brother is in the darkness, and walketh in the darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because the darkness hath blinded his eyes.

units.leftText: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.
units.rightText: I write unto you, my little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

units.leftText: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.
units.rightText: I write unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the evil one. I have written unto you, little children, because ye know the Father.
leftNotes: 2:13 Or you have overcome evil; also in verse 14

units.leftText: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one. Do Not Love the World
units.rightText: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye know him who is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the evil one.

units.leftText: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
units.rightText: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

units.leftText: For all that is in the world — the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life — is not from the Father but from the world.
units.rightText: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh and the lust of the eyes and the vainglory of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

units.leftText: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever. Beware of Antichrists
units.rightText: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

units.leftText: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.
units.rightText: Little children, it is the last hour: and as ye heard that antichrist cometh, even now have there arisen many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last hour.

units.leftText: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
units.rightText: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they all are not of us.

units.leftText: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
units.rightText: And ye have an anointing from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
leftNotes: 2:20 BYZ and TR and you know all things

units.leftText: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
units.rightText: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

units.leftText: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
units.rightText: Who is the liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, even he that denieth the Father and the Son.

units.leftText: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well. Remain in Christ
units.rightText: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that confesseth the Son hath the Father also.

units.leftText: As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.
units.rightText: As for you, let that abide in you which ye heard from the beginning. If that which ye heard from the beginning abide in you, ye also shall abide in the Son, and in the Father.

units.leftText: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
units.rightText: And this is the promise which he promised us, even the life eternal.

units.leftText: I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.
units.rightText: These things have I written unto you concerning them that would lead you astray.

units.leftText: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
units.rightText: And as for you, the anointing which ye received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any one teach you; but as his anointing teacheth you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, ye abide in him.

units.leftText: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
units.rightText: And now, my little children, abide in him; that, if he shall be manifested, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
leftNotes: 2:28 Literally remain in Him

units.leftText: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.
units.rightText: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one also that doeth righteousness is begotten of him.

units.leftText: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
units.rightText: Behold what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called children of God; and such we are. For this cause the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

units.leftText: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
units.rightText: Beloved, now are we children of God, and it is not yet made manifest what we shall be. We know that, if he shall be manifested, we shall be like him; for we shall see him even as he is.
leftNotes: 3:2 Literally when He appears or when it appears

units.leftText: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
units.rightText: And every one that hath this hope set on him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
leftNotes: 3:3 Literally just as He is pure

units.leftText: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
units.rightText: Every one that doeth sin doeth also lawlessness; and sin is lawlessness.
leftNotes: 3:4 Or is violation of the Law

units.leftText: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.
units.rightText: And ye know that he was manifested to take away sins; and in him is no sin.

units.leftText: No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.
units.rightText: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither knoweth him.

units.leftText: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
units.rightText: My little children, let no man lead you astray: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous:
leftNotes: 3:7 NA Young children in training
3:7 Literally He is righteous

units.leftText: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
units.rightText: he that doeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. To this end was the Son of God manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

units.leftText: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.
units.rightText: Whosoever is begotten of God doeth no sin, because his seed abideth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is begotten of God.

units.leftText: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother. Love One Another (John 13:31–35|JHN 13:31-35*; Romans 12:9–13|ROM 12:9-13*)
units.rightText: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

units.leftText: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
units.rightText: For this is the message which ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another:

units.leftText: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.
units.rightText: not as Cain was of the evil one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

units.leftText: So do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
units.rightText: Marvel not, brethren, if the world hateth you.

units.leftText: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.
units.rightText: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not abideth in death.

units.leftText: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
units.rightText: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

units.leftText: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
units.rightText: Hereby know we love, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

units.leftText: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
units.rightText: But whoso hath the world’s goods, and beholdeth his brother in need, and shutteth up his compassion from him, how doth the love of God abide in him?

units.leftText: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
units.rightText: My little children, let us not love in word, neither with the tongue; but in deed and truth.

units.leftText: And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:
units.rightText: Hereby shall we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our heart before him:

units.leftText: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
units.rightText: because if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

units.leftText: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
units.rightText: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, we have boldness toward God;

units.leftText: and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.
units.rightText: and whatsoever we ask we receive of him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

units.leftText: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.
units.rightText: And this is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he gave us commandment.

units.leftText: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
units.rightText: And he that keepeth his commandments abideth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

units.leftText: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
units.rightText: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

units.leftText: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
units.rightText: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

units.leftText: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
units.rightText: and every spirit that confesseth not Jesus is not of God: and this is the spirit of the antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it cometh; and now it is in the world already.
leftNotes: 4:3 BYZ and TR that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh

units.leftText: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
units.rightText: Ye are of God, my little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world.

units.leftText: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.
units.rightText: They are of the world: therefore speak they as of the world, and the world heareth them.

units.leftText: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception. Love Comes from God
units.rightText: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he who is not of God heareth us not. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
leftNotes: 4:6 Or spirit

units.leftText: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
units.rightText: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is begotten of God, and knoweth God.

units.leftText: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
units.rightText: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

units.leftText: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
units.rightText: Herein was the love of God manifested in us, that God hath sent his only begotten Son into the world that we might live through him.
leftNotes: 4:9 Or only begotten or unique

units.leftText: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
units.rightText: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
leftNotes: 4:10 Or as a propitiation

units.leftText: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
units.rightText: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

units.leftText: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
units.rightText: No man hath beheld God at any time: if we love one another, God abideth in us, and his love is perfected in us:

units.leftText: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
units.rightText: hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

units.leftText: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
units.rightText: And we have beheld and bear witness that the Father hath sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

units.leftText: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
units.rightText: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abideth in him, and he in God.

units.leftText: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
units.rightText: And we know and have believed the love which God hath in us. God is love; and he that abideth in love abideth in God, and God abideth in him.

units.leftText: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
units.rightText: Herein is love made perfect with us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as he is, even so are we in this world.

units.leftText: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
units.rightText: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.

units.leftText: We love because He first loved us.
units.rightText: We love, because he first loved us.
leftNotes: 4:19 BYZ and TR We love Him

units.leftText: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
units.rightText: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, cannot love God whom he hath not seen.

units.leftText: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
units.rightText: And this commandment have we from him, that he who loveth God love his brother also.

units.leftText: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
units.rightText: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is begotten of God: and whosoever loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
leftNotes: 5:1 Literally and everyone loving the One having begotten also loves the one having been begotten from Him.

units.leftText: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
units.rightText: Hereby we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and do his commandments.

units.leftText: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
units.rightText: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

units.leftText: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
units.rightText: For whatsoever is begotten of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that hath overcome the world, even our faith.

units.leftText: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
units.rightText: And who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

units.leftText: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ — not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
units.rightText: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and with the blood.

units.leftText: For there are three that testify:
units.rightText: And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is the truth.
leftNotes: 5:7 TR and PT three that testify in heaven: The Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one. 8*And there are three that testify on earth:

units.leftText: the Spirit, the water, and the blood — and these three are in agreement. God’s Testimony about His Son
units.rightText: For there are three who bear witness, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and the three agree in one.

units.leftText: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
units.rightText: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for the witness of God is this, that he hath borne witness concerning his Son.

units.leftText: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
units.rightText: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in him: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he hath not believed in the witness that God hath borne concerning his Son.

units.leftText: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
units.rightText: And the witness is this, that God gave unto us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

units.leftText: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life. Effective Prayer
units.rightText: He that hath the Son hath the life; he that hath not the Son of God hath not the life.

units.leftText: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
units.rightText: These things have I written unto you, that ye may know that ye have eternal life, even unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God.
leftNotes: 5:13 BYZ and TR include and that you may believe in the name of the Son of God.

units.leftText: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
units.rightText: And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us:

units.leftText: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
units.rightText: and if we know that he heareth us whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

units.leftText: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
units.rightText: If any man see his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: not concerning this do I say that he should make request.

units.leftText: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death. The True God
units.rightText: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

units.leftText: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
units.rightText: We know that whosoever is begotten of God sinneth not; but he that was begotten of God keepeth himself, and the evil one toucheth him not.
leftNotes: 5:18 Or the one who was born of God protects himself or God protects the one born of Him
5:18 Or evil; similarly in verse 19

units.leftText: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
units.rightText: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in the evil one.

units.leftText: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true — in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
units.rightText: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

units.leftText: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
units.rightText: My little children, guard yourselves from idols.
leftNotes: 5:21 BYZ and TR include Amen.
